verdict.rationale: TruffleHog lets you filter findings by verification status, which serves as a confidence signal. The `--only-verified` flag and `--results=verified,unknown` combined with `--fail` gate a pre-commit or CI run on those result classes, so unverified noise need not block builds. There is no evidence of severity-based filtering, and gating is only shown in a pre-commit hook context. missing for 10: severity-level classification and filtering, documented CI-pipeline gating configuration beyond the pre-commit example, independent or hands-on corroboration of noise reduction.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter and gate on findings by severity or confidence so low-value noise does not block builds

citations.quote: for every secret trufflehog can classify, it can also log in to confirm if that secret is live or not
